# Engage Youth Foundation

> Machine-readable site summary. Public content mirrors https://engage-youth.org.

## Organization
- Name: Engage Youth Foundation
- Type: US non-profit organization
- Mission: Engage, empower, and mobilize youth through programs, mentorship, and community projects (Pacific Northwest focus).

## Primary URLs
- Home: /
- About: /about-us
- News & social: /news-and-social-media
- Donation: /donation
- Volunteer request: /request-for-volunteer
- FAQ: /faq
- Events (upcoming): /activities
- Past events: /past-events
- Volunteer with us: /volunteer-with-us
- Contact: /contact-us
- Privacy: /privacy-policy

## Thematic pillars (homepage)
- Ecological sustainability
- Fighting homelessness
- Food drives and distribution
- Youth financial literacy

## Contact
- Use the Contact page form for inquiries: /contact-us

## Technical
- Stack: Next.js (App Router), TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, GSAP ScrollTrigger, Supabase, Sanity CMS, Cloudinary, Cloudflare Pages/Workers, Turnstile.
